evidence_summary.cross_client_rotation_response: HTTP 200; returned client_id equaled the separately created victim client id
evidence_summary.secret_handling: Only SHA-256 prefixes of test secrets are persisted; bearer tokens and cleartext secrets are excluded.

reason: The vulnerable endpoint authorizes the operation solely with the global client:update scope. A separate attacker OAuth client with that single scope successfully called POST /api/v1/oauth/client/{victim_id}/secret, invalidated the victim credential, and received a usable replacement credential for the victim client.
